name: Admin Assistant and Smartsheet Update - Project B

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    id AS "rowId", 
    "Task Name",
    "Comments", 
    "Percentage Complete"
FROM public."task_master_project_b"
WHERE 
    -- This forces both the DB column AND your n8n input to lowercase
    LOWER(TRIM("Task id")) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json.taskId }}'))
    OR 
    -- Backup check: matches if the user just sent the row number
    id::text = TRIM('{{ $json.taskId }}')
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO public.task_history_project_b (
    sender_phone, 
    task_id, 
    percentage_reported, 
    raw_message, 
    created_at
)
VALUES (
    '{{ $json.senderPhone }}',
    '{{ $json.taskId }}',
    '{{ $json.percentage }}',
    '{{ ($json.Comments || $json.raw_message || "No Comment").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    NOW()
);
SELECT * FROM public.task_history_project_b ORDER BY created_at DESC;

INSERT INTO public.admin_query_project_b (
    admin_phone, 
    raw_query, 
    query_type, 
    searched_employee, 
    created_at
)
SELECT 
    '{{ $node["Message analyzer"].json.adminContext.remoteJid }}', 
    '{{ ($node["Webhook"].json.body.data.message.conversation || "Command").replace(/'/g, "''") }}', 
    '{{ $node["Message analyzer"].json.adminContext.filter }}',
    '{{ $node["Formatter node"].json.targetName || "None" }}',
    NOW()
WHERE '{{ $node["Message analyzer"].json.adminContext.isCommand }}' = 'false';

SELECT searched_employee 
FROM public.admin_query_project_b 
WHERE admin_phone = '{{ $node["Webhook"].json.body.data.key.remoteJid }}' 
AND searched_employee IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created_at DESC 
LIMIT 1;
